entities.summary: Donovan Solano Preciado, nicknamed "Donnie Barrels", is a Colombian professional baseball infielder who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Miami Marlins, New York Yankees, San Francisco Giants, Cincinnati Reds, Minnesota Twins, San Diego Padres, Seattle Mariners and Texas Rangers.
